estimand.interpretation: Effect associated with original List 1 assignment under the stated design assumptions, not the mechanical effect of a continuously active 25 percent duty.

product_mapping.rule: Map HTS10 observations to a 2017 HS6 family using official Census history; never use fuzzy description matching.
product_mapping.exact_2016_to_2017_continuity_rule: When a 2016 WCO HS6 relation is partial or one-to-many, adopt the 2017 six-digit prefix only if the identical official Census HTS10 exists in both annual concordances, its full description and both quantity units match exactly after whitespace/case normalization, the code is historically valid in both years, and that prefix is an explicit WCO candidate. Otherwise retain ambiguity.

treatment_assignment.treated: Canonical HS6 families whose pre-policy China import value is entirely linked to original List 1 HTS8 assignments.
treatment_assignment.control: Canonical HS6 families with zero direct exposure to the listed concurrent trade actions during the analysis window.
treatment_assignment.mixed: Exclude families with treatment exposure strictly between zero and one from the primary binary design.
treatment_assignment.treated_concurrent_action_overlap: A family that is pure List 1 by pre-policy China value but also contains scope from List 2, List 3, Section 232, or Section 201 is flagged and excluded from the primary treated sample because the outcome is measured at the whole HS6 family level.
treatment_assignment.exclusions: Keep original List 1 assignment for the primary intention-to-treat design; attach product exclusions as metadata and remove ever-excluded families in a sensitivity analysis.

control_contamination_exclusions: Section 232 steel and aluminum actions affecting China in 2018
Section 201 washer and solar safeguard actions effective 2018-02-07

matching.industry_rule: Require exactly one NAICS3 candidate for both treated and control families; ambiguous or missing NAICS3 is excluded from primary matching rather than guessed.

feature_definitions.log_mean_monthly_china_import_value: log1p of the arithmetic mean of 29 monthly China import values, including zero months
feature_definitions.pretrend_slope: OLS slope of log1p monthly China import value on month index 0 through 28, in log points per month
feature_definitions.monthly_volatility: sample standard deviation of the 29 log1p monthly China import values
feature_definitions.china_share_of_all_origin_imports: sum of China import value divided by sum of all-origin import value over the 29-month clean pre-period

matching.standardization: Within each NAICS3, transform the four continuous features using the eligible control-pool mean and sample standard deviation; a zero-SD feature contributes zero distance and is reported.
matching.distance: Euclidean distance over the four within-NAICS3 standardized continuous features.
matching.tie_break: Sort by distance and then control_hs6 ascending.
matching.edge_weight: Each selected control receives weight 1/3 within a treated family; reuse across treated families accumulates weight.
matching.coverage_denominator: All eligible treated candidates from Phase 07, including those later excluded for ambiguous or missing NAICS3.
matching.balance_smd: For each continuous feature, compare the unweighted matched-treated mean with the edge-weighted matched-control mean and divide by the pooled sample standard deviation of the pre-match, unique-NAICS3 eligible treated and control pools.

matching_refinement_experiment.reason: The frozen three-nearest-neighbour run passed coverage but failed balance for pretrend slope and China share; it also produced control ESS 52.16 and maximum reuse 33.
matching_refinement_experiment.candidate_population: The same Phase 09 candidates with exactly one NAICS3; no eligibility or industry labels are changed.
matching_refinement_experiment.objective: Minimize total frozen standardized Euclidean distance after satisfying assignment, exact-industry, reuse, and balance constraints.
matching_refinement_experiment.tie_break: Use lexicographic treated_hs6 and control_hs6 order as a deterministic secondary objective.
matching_refinement_experiment.distance_threshold_origin: The mean and p95 caps equal 125 percent of the frozen failed-run baselines 0.8287317292296009 and 2.199299793772, fixed before v2 execution.
matching_refinement_experiment.stop_rule: If the integer problem is infeasible or any adoption threshold fails, retain the audit output and stop before pretrend; do not inspect post-policy outcomes or relax the rule in the same experiment.

matching_cardinality_experiment.reason: The v2 optimization forced all 284 unique-NAICS3 treated families even though the original coverage gate requires only 252 of all 315 treated candidates; policy-pre overlap trimming may recover a transparent balanced subpopulation.
matching_cardinality_experiment.estimand_change: If adopted, results apply only to the matched policy-pre overlap subpopulation, not to every original List 1 treated family.
matching_cardinality_experiment.candidate_population: The same 284 treated and 829 control candidates with exactly one NAICS3; no Phase 07 eligibility label is changed.
matching_cardinality_experiment.stage_one_objective: Maximize the number of included treated families subject to all hard constraints and minimum coverage.
matching_cardinality_experiment.stage_two_objective: Fix the maximum feasible treated count, then minimize total frozen standardized Euclidean distance with deterministic lexicographic tie-breaking.
matching_cardinality_experiment.excluded_treated_output: Every policy-pre trimmed treated HS6 must be listed with its NAICS3 and overlap diagnostics; no exclusion may use a post-policy outcome.
matching_cardinality_experiment.stop_rule: If maximum feasible treated count is below 252 or any final gate fails, stop the matching route, retain the failure evidence, do not design a fourth matching experiment, and do not estimate a causal effect.

stop_conditions: Official mapping cannot meet coverage or ambiguity thresholds.
The clean control pool does not meet minimum sample or matching coverage.
Pre-policy balance or pretrend thresholds fail.
Results reverse sign under the frozen immediate-window, unweighted, and ever-excluded-family sensitivity checks.
A result can only be produced by changing controls after observing post-policy outcomes.

ai_application.name: TradeShock AI evidence-grounded trade-policy analyst
ai_application.purpose: Let a language model route natural-language questions to read-only deterministic data tools, return source-linked calculations, and refuse causal claims when the causal readiness gates are blocked.
mvp_non_goals: No arbitrary SQL generated by the model
No autonomous web crawling or unverified source substitution
No event-study result while causal status is blocked
No LangChain or LangGraph before the plain Python tool contracts are tested
ai_application.model_boundary: The model interprets the question, selects a declared tool, and writes a response; Python/MySQL tools calculate numbers, enforce time windows, attach sources, and decide whether causal language is permitted.
ai_application.causal_safety_rule: If causal_control_design.status is any blocked state, including blocked_before_pretrend_v3, the assistant may report descriptive changes and the blocking evidence but must not state or imply a causal tariff effect.

evaluation.leakage_rule: Gold answers and hidden evaluation labels are separated from prompts; causal questions cannot reveal post-policy outcomes to the selection or routing logic.
evaluation.stop_rule: If unsupported causal claims are nonzero or a core accuracy threshold fails, do not publish the demo; inspect the tool contract and evidence bundle before changing prompts.

source_access_note: Direct command-line requests to the Census reference workbook returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-31. The official browser-supported download route was then used and all source hashes were verified; no unofficial mirror was substituted.
